authority: This file is the single source of truth for makinyx.com's intended DNS state. Cloudflare's dashboard is where it is applied; scripts/dns-guard.js verifies the two agree. Change this file first, then Cloudflare — never the other way round.

nameservers.why: Cloudflare Registrar contractually requires Cloudflare nameservers. Delegating to ns1/ns2.vercel-dns.com is not possible without transferring the registrar away, and is a deliberate no per the decision record. The suffix, not the exact pair, is enforced because Cloudflare may reassign the assigned nameserver pair for an account.

tls.why: Vercel issues via Let's Encrypt. Cloudflare's Universal SSL for the zone has historically issued via Google Trust Services and Sectigo. Any issuer outside this list on a live makinyx.com hostname is a mis-issuance signal, not a config change.

caa.why: Restricts which CAs may issue for the zone. issuewild is deliberately NOT set: under RFC 8659 the issue property then governs wildcard issuance too, which keeps Cloudflare's Universal SSL wildcard renewals working without a second record to keep in sync. Flip enforce to true once the records exist in Cloudflare.

dnssec.why: Cloudflare is both registrar and DNS operator here, so enabling DNSSEC is one click and Cloudflare publishes the DS record to the .com registry itself. Validating resolvers then reject forged answers for makinyx.com. Flip enforce to true once the DS record is published.

email.dmarc: v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:byosekumbuga@gmail.com; ruf=mailto:byosekumbuga@gmail.com; fo=1; aspf=s; adkim=s
email.why: makinyx.com neither sends nor receives mail today, so the M3AAWG parked-domain baseline applies: RFC 7505 null MX, an SPF record authorising nobody, and DMARC p=reject. Without these the domain is trivially spoofable in Mike's name.
email.reversalTrigger: Standing up privacy@makinyx.com via Cloudflare Email Routing (reminder item 2/2b) REQUIRES removing the null MX and replacing it with Cloudflare's routing MX records, and relaxing SPF. Update this file in the same change.
